title: Ex 1.2 #7 · {∅} × {0, ∅} × {0, 1}
prompt: List the elements of $\{\emptyset\} \times \{0, \emptyset\} \times \{0, 1\}$ between braces.
answer_format: A set of tuples between braces, like {(1, a, 0), (2, b, 1)}. Steps are optional.
hints: A product of three sets is a set of ordered triples; ∅ can be an entry.
There is 1 choice for the first entry, 2 for the second and 2 for the third.
solution: Each element is a triple whose first entry is ∅, second entry 0 or ∅, and third entry 0 or 1.
